title: Make the text of the selected equipment bolder
goal: Combine :checked with adjacent sibling selectors to track the true check status.
summary: The checkbox itself retains the original appearance. After checking, the label text next to it is bolded for easy reading.
tasks: When the check box is selected, reset the span word adjacent to it to 700.
When unchecked or canceled again, the text returns to normal font weight.

example.note: When the input is selected, the span immediately following it will match.

hint: uses :checked to detect the real-time status, and the attribute selector [checked] only checks the initial attributes.
